Hi Elena — thanks for the scope doc and for the clear ask. Yes, we can definitely run a consolidated intake that bundles SOC 2 controls review, DPA clarifications, and the pen-test vendor handoff. That format often saves time and surface area for follow-ups.

Who we'll bring from Redwood: Olga (controls & evidence lead) will run the controls walk-through; Connor will own operations/bridge and pen-test logistics. I'll coordinate the schedule and calendar invites.

Suggested agenda for a 2-hour block:
1) Introductions & scope alignment (10 min)
2) Controls walk (SOC 2) — mapped to evidence expectations (50 min)
3) DPA open items — legal highlights (20 min)
4) Break / buffer (10 min)
5) Pen-test intake: scoping + vendor onboarding (25 min)
6) Next steps & action items (5 min)

Candidate slots (UTC):
- Tue Sep 29 09:00–11:00 UTC
- Wed Sep 30 14:00–16:00 UTC

Pre-reqs from FinBridge: please upload the items in the folder below at least 48 hours before the session: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2b3CsecureEvidence
We also maintain a short evidence checklist (attached) that maps typical SOC 2 artifacts to what our reviewers expect — see redwood-evidence-checklist.xlsx.

If either slot works, we can lock it; if you need the legal team to have a separate quick pre-call, note that and we'll try to schedule a 20–30 minute legal-only window immediately before the main session.

— Hannah
